title: Strict henselization quotients are free over base quotients
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with maximal ideal n, and let A^{\mathrm{sh}} be its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of the residue field [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. There is a set X such that, for every r\ge1, the A/n^r-module A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r is free on the images of X; consequently the inverse limit T=\varprojlim_r A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r is the n-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] of the free A-module \bigoplus_{x\in X}A.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07QM (lemma-dumb-properties-henselization), part (4), and the completion identification in Lemma Tag 06LJ(c)
